subject: Trebuchet security intake: SOC 2 / pen test / DPA coordination
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Park <alice@trebuchet.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Sep 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Trebuchet: SOC 2 + pen-test intake and proposed windows

Hi Alice,

Thanks for the quick intake call yesterday — following up with a couple of concrete options to run the compliance walkthrough (SOC 2 scope, pen test orientation, and DPA review). We typically block 60 minutes for the joint walkthrough (45 min walkthrough + 15 min Q&A). Can you confirm which of these work on your side?

- Wednesday 16 Sep — 10:00–11:00 PT / 13:00–14:00 ET
- Thursday 17 Sep — 08:00–09:00 PT / 11:00–12:00 ET
- Friday 18 Sep — 16:00–17:00 PT / 19:00–20:00 ET (we understand evenings may be tight)

I’ve attached our SOC2-Prep-Checklist and the vendor questionnaire you requested (stubbed below). If you prefer, we can split into two sessions: SOC2 & DPA first, then a short pen-test scoping call with Tom from PenSecure.

Attachments: SOC2-Prep-Checklist.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

Next steps: confirm a preferred slot and the attendee list from Trebuchet (security, legal, procurement). I’ll put a tentative hold and include a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) in the invite.

Thanks — Jasmine

--
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Redwood Inference — Production-first inference platform for LLMs

From: Alice Park <alice@trebuchet.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom@pensecure.io>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 11:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Trebuchet: SOC 2 + pen-test intake and proposed windows

Hi Jasmine — thanks, those options look good. A couple notes from our side before we lock a time:

- Preferred attendees: myself (security), Marco Diaz (IT ops), and Sarah Lee (procurement).
- We need the vendor questionnaire filled out in advance if possible; I attached our Trebuchet-Vendor-Questionnaire.xlsx.
- Avoid Friday evenings if possible — our legal team is off that day.

Available windows for our group this week:
- Wednesday 16 Sep — 10:00–11:00 PT (works for us)
- Thursday 17 Sep — only after 13:00 PT (so not the 08:00 slot)

Tom from PenSecure is CC’d — he’s happy to join the latter half of the session for scoping. We prefer to do SOC2/DPA first, then a 15–20 minute pen-test scoping segment.

Attachment: Trebuchet-Vendor-Questionnaire.xlsx (XLSX, 1 sheet)

If Wednesday 10:00 PT is fine, please send calendar invite + MAP.

Best,
Alice

--
Alice Park
Head of Security, Trebuchet Financial
alice@trebuchet.com | +1 (212) 555-0147

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Park <alice@trebuchet.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom@pensecure.io>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trebuchet: SOC 2 + pen-test intake and proposed windows

Alice — thanks for the quick response and for attaching the questionnaire. I ran this with our ops calendar and want to flag a small conflict: our security engineer who leads pen-test scoping is booked for a critical red-team run on Wednesday morning and won’t be available at 10:00 PT. Apologies for the late notice.

Two options to resolve:
1) Keep the 60-minute session on Wednesday 16 Sep 10:00–11:00 PT but we’ll split attendees: Jasmine and I will run the SOC2/DPA walkthrough; Tom (PenSecure) and our lead will follow up in a 30-minute pen-scoping call on Friday 18 Sep 09:00–09:30 PT. We’ll put concrete MAP items for the follow-up.
2) Move the full joint session to Thursday 17 Sep at 13:30–14:30 PT (we can expand to 75 minutes to allow pen scoping without a separate call).

Quick MAP (draft) — please confirm:
- Redwood: deliver architecture diagram + SOC2 control mapping (pre-read) — target: 48 hours before the walkthrough
- Trebuchet: return completed Vendor Questionnaire and attendee list — target: 24 hours before the walkthrough
- If pen scoping is separate: agree on scope doc and target start date for pen test within 14 days after walkthrough

We can also send the DPA for signature pre-call if your legal team prefers; happy to route via DocuSign.

Attachment: SOC2-Prep-Checklist.pdf (re-sent for convenience)

Please let me know which option you prefer. If you want, I’ll propose calendar invites for both and mark one as tentative.

Thanks — Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0110

From: Alice Park <alice@trebuchet.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Trebuchet: SOC 2 + pen-test intake and proposed windows

Rishi — thanks for the heads up. Option 1 works best for our availability: go ahead and run the SOC2/DPA walkthrough on Wednesday 16 Sep 10:00–11:00 PT with Jasmine and you; Tom will join for the last 20 minutes for quick pen scoping, and we’ll schedule the dedicated pen-scoping follow-up on Friday 18 Sep 09:00–09:30 PT.

I’ve uploaded the completed questionnaire and attendee list to the HubSpot deal (see link). Please send the calendar invites and the MAP. We’d appreciate the DPA draft routed via DocuSign so our legal team can review before Friday.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567/TRB-2026-09-001
Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=trebuchet-security-walkthrough-0916
